name: Corridor ~Meikairou~
source: Rumina never new her father and her mother suddenly passed away. On the dying bed her mother gave her a note with a name on it, so having nowhere else to go Rumina came to this mysterious person in search of shelter. She was allowed to get inside. But this new family has a lot of dark secrets that she will have to face now.
translation: 瑠未奈从未见过父亲，母亲也突然离世。临终时，母亲交给她一张写着某人姓名的字条。无处可去的瑠未奈便前去寻找这个神秘的人，希望得到收留。对方允许她住下，但这个新家庭藏着许多黑暗的秘密，而她如今必须面对这一切。
